entries.086b432ad03d3d17: Revenue recorded on a continuing basis from rent received from store operators and renewal fees received upon contract renewal, for properties under sublease contracts. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥15,688 million.
entries.2a99d793e90beb01: A business in which consolidated subsidiary Asset Innovation Co., Ltd. purchases and sells store real estate, primarily targeting small and medium-sized properties in central urban areas with high marketability. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company sold 7 properties and acquired 6 properties, and the number of properties held at fiscal year-end was 3. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,209 million.
entries.7fa01470fb7cdef4: Purchase and Sale of Store Real Estate
entries.831d1ab482c189ed: A business in which consolidated subsidiary Tempo Innovation Co., Ltd. subleases store properties leased from property owners to store operators such as restaurants. This includes the store rent guarantee business. As of March 31, 2026, the number of sublease properties was 3,021, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥17,803 million.
entries.993b230e33c68c50: Revenue recorded on a one-time basis from fees such as key money received when leased properties are subleased to store operators, and from selling fixtures and other items of properties with existing fixtures to store operators. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,114 million.
entries.ce511bcd12ab3b20: Introduction of Properties with Existing Fixtures
entries.d0a99294c7ca27ee: A holding company that conducts subleasing of store properties for restaurants and buying and selling of store real estate through its consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.d3b6f98438dcfebd: A business operated by consolidated subsidiary Safety Innovation Co., Ltd., under which, based on guarantee entrustment contracts with store operators and others, when a tenant becomes unable to pay rent and other charges, it pays the rent to the landlord on the tenant's behalf and receives a guarantee fee in return. Revenue is included in the Store Sublease Business segment, and the breakdown amounts are not disclosed.
